attempts.actualText: AROUND YOUR HOME What’s on your to-do list? From a single fitting to a list of little repairs. Explore the kinds of work Steve helps with. 01 — INDOORS REPAIR · FIT · IMPROVE Shelves up. Little fixes done. Practical repairs and fittings, from shelves and cupboards to handrails and kitchen tap replacements. Shelves & cupboards Handrails & small repairs Kitchen tap replacements Wall-mounted TVs 02 — OUTDOORS ASSEMBLE · REPAIR More from your outdoor space. Help with timber buildings and outdoor jobs, including sheds, summerhouses and decking. Sheds & summerhouses Decking Outdoor handrails One small job is a good place to start. Not sure where your job fits? Describe it when you get in touch.
